summary: OrbitLab is an interactive space mission design and orbital simulation platform featuring numerical orbital propagation, spacecraft engineering analysis, 3D trajectory visualisation, and real NASA/JPL Horizons planetary ephemeris integration. Built with Python, FastAPI, React and SciPy for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.
details:
OrbitLab – Interactive Space Mission Simulation Platform

Overview

OrbitLab is a software platform focused on making space mission concepts accessible through interactive simulations and visual exploration.

How It Works

OrbitLab provides an interactive environment in which users can explore and simulate space-related mission scenarios. Its software architecture brings together the user interface, simulation logic, and visualization components to present mission information in an understandable format.

Benefits and Intended Impact

  • Makes complex space mission concepts easier to understand.
  • Encourages interactive exploration and experimentation.
  • Supports technology-driven space education.
  • Demonstrates the potential of software simulations in understanding space systems.

Technology and Implementation

The platform's actual programming languages, frameworks, simulation engines, APIs, and data sources are documented in the project's source code and technical documentation.

Innovation

OrbitLab focuses on turning space-related concepts into an interactive software experience rather than presenting them only through static educational material.
